text: Gomɗii hujjaaji ɓannguɗi arii on onon yimɓe ɓen, immorde ka Joomi mon : kala jaɓuɗo ɗi o taskii, o nafitoray, kala kadi wumnaaɗo e majji, o salii taskaade ɗi, lorra mun ko e makko yanata. Min mi wonaali reenoowo on, lima golle mon. Min ko mi Nulaaɗo immorde ka Joomi am, ko Kanko woni Reenoowo on.
